children.value: dṛṣṭo'dyāpi hi duḥkhāya keyamāsthā sukhaṃ prati
pratyabdaṃ pratimāsaṃ ca pratyahaṃ ca pratikṣaṇam
sukhāni duḥkhapiṇḍāni duḥkhāni tu punaḥ punaḥ
parāmṛṣṭaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ naṣṭaṃ na bhāvitam
atrasthaṃ na tadastīha satāṃ yatrāstu saṃsthitiḥ
adya ye mahatāṃ mūrdhni te dinairnipatantyadhaḥ
ka ime me mahābhogāḥ ka ime mama bāndhavāḥ
yātu tiṣṭhatu vā samyaṅ mamaitāṃ prati ko grahaḥ
sarvaṃ smṛtipathaṃ prāptaṃ vartamāne'pi kā dhṛtiḥ
kva dhanāni mahīpānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kva jaganti vā
svaṃ pratyagātmabhūtaṃ yatparamaṃ padaṃ tasya dṛṣṭayaḥ sākṣātkārāḥ
yeṣu yeṣu dṛḍhā baddhā bhāvanā bhavyavastuṣu
yeṣu yeṣu padārtheṣu dhṛtiṃ badhnāti mānavaḥ
teṣu teṣveva tasyāyaṃ dṛṣṭo nāśodayo bhṛśam
śeṣe kalatracintārtaḥ kiṃ karoti kadā jaḍaḥ
ko'sau svargo'sti bhūmau vā pātāle vā pradeśakaḥ
jāyante ca mriyante ca prākṛtāḥ kṣudrajantavaḥ
tādṛśāḥ puruṣāḥ santi mādṛśāṃ gaṇanaiva kā
tattā api mahārambhā hanta manye mahāpadaḥ
tattā api mahārambhā manye manasi saṃpadaḥ

evaṃ yā dāridryabandhurājyādināśalakṣaṇā āpadopi yadi
sādhusaṅgatīrthatapaḥprabodhādiprāpaṇena vicitrāḥ śreya eveti manasi
saṃmatāścettā api vivekavairāgyādimahārambhāḥ saṃpada eva manye ityarthaḥ
saṃsāra eva duḥkhānāṃ sīmānta iti kathyate
mano nāma nihanmyenaṃ manasāsmi ciraṃ hataḥ

ripumatibalinaṃ mano nihatya
praśamamupaimi namo'stu te viveka
